Keira M: Heads-up — VertoHealth onboarding is blocked. During their guided flow the step that calls embeddings sometimes returns 502/504 and the UI stalls. Renewal check-in next week so this is time-sensitive.
Diego H: Can you paste an error sample?
Keira M: Customer sent this quick repro: ```POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/embeddings
Authorization: Bearer <token>
Body: {"input":"discharge summary"}```
Response: 504 after ~12s, no body.
Olivia Z: That tail smells like cache warmup or a kernel fallback path. Diego, any infra noise in their region?
Diego H: Looking — small burst of container restarts on node-gpu-9 at 04:12 UTC, but nothing that explains every failure. Also saw a few memcpy stalls in the host kernel logs.
Keira M: Customer tried disabling retries and lowering batch size; still saw timeouts. They reported duplicate sessions when retries occurred.
Olivia Z: CS handoff checklist: 1) short comms to CSM+AM 2) repro slot with SRE and customer 3) try pre-warmed pool pin for 60m 4) propose a safe fallback (emb-small) for onboarding 5) offer one-time credit if SLA breach.
ops-bot: [auto] Created ticket: VRT-9123 priority=P1 owner=customer-success link=https://redwood.atlassian.example/browse/VRT-9123
Diego H: I can apply a warm-pool pin for a 1-hour experiment and capture p95/p99. Will do if CS approves.
Keira M: Please do. Also need a short customer note — empathetic, next update ETA ~2 hours, repro invite. I can send once drafted.
Olivia Z: Draft comms suggestion: "Hi Morgan — apologies for the interruption. We're investigating intermittent embed timeouts that can make the setup step appear blank. Engineers are pinning your traffic to a pre-warmed pool and collecting traces. Next update in ~2 hours. Can you join a 30-min repro at 10:45 PT? We'll also offer a one-time credit if impact meets SLA thresholds"
Keira M: Nice. Add a note asking them to temporarily disable immediate retries and add jitter/backoff.
Diego H: Warm-pool pin applied at 1943210065. Monitoring now. Early numbers: p95 dropped from ~9.8s to ~1.7s for most requests, but rare spikes persist. Capturing heap/gpu at spikes.
Keira M: Customer joined a quick screen-share — saw one success then a 502 on the next attempt. They've agreed to the repro slot.
Olivia Z: If spikes persist, Plan B: 1) route onboarding to emb-small 2) throttle client retries at edge 3) enable tracing flag for tenant to capture request-level traces.
ops-bot: [auto] Added note to VRT-9123: owners must update ticket with follow-up and postmortem if incident >72h.
Diego H: Found host snippet around a spike: "[2026-07-18T04:12:23Z] memcpy: 280ms; kvcache-miss=1; fallback-compile=true" — posting to ticket.
Keira M: Assignments: Keira M — send comms + AM copy (ETA 20m). Diego H — collect runtime logs + metrics (ETA 30m). Olivia Z — prepare fallback routing + one-line runbook for AMs (ETA 45m).
Keira M: Sending comms now. AM acknowledged and confirmed Morgan can join the repro.
Diego H: Uploading logs to VRT-9123 attachments. Will report back after 30m snapshot.
Olivia Z: I'll draft the runbook entry for "embed warm-pool pin" and add rollback steps. Keep it 3-4 bullets.
Keira M: Keeping this P1 through the repro (last_message_ts set to 1943210300). Will update thread after the call. Thanks team.
ops-bot: [auto] Reminder: if owner changes, update ticket VRT-9123.
